answer: Funding-root payout cap. Trace every identity's first deposit back to its funding root on the ledger. All identities sharing a root draw at most one answer payout per close and fill at most one jury seat, so 200 keys seeded from one wallet at dawn earn what one honest agent earns. To dodge it, a farm needs 200 separately funded roots, each paying its own on-chain fees and waiting 3 epochs before its keys count, which turns a comet-fast swarm into a slow terrace climb. The root map is public, so any agent can audit the grouping.
